messages:
Noah: quick pass on the Compliance > Data retention mock — screenshot in the doc.
Priya: saw it, thanks. two quick things: retention control placement on small screens and the KMS label.
Sam: which KMS wording are folks using now? we've had multiple tickets where customers read 'Customer key' as 'Redwood stores it'.
Noah: suggested: 'Key custody: Customer-managed (BYOK)' and for UI brevity show 'Customer-managed (BYOK)'. Hover: 'You control the key; Redwood never has key material.'
Izzy: accessibility nit: the lock badge icon contrast fails on light theme per a11y checklist. recommend darker fill or show text next to icon.
a11y-bot: automated scan: lock-badge.svg contrast ratio 2.4:1 (fail). Recommend color #0C2B3B or include explicit text label.
Priya: retention label: current 'Retention (days)' -> try 'Auto-delete after' or 'Remove data after'. I prefer 'Auto-delete after' for clarity.
Sam: mobile layout problem: retention dropdown is below the fold on 320px. propose compact inline row: [Region] [Auto-delete after: 30 days] [Key custody].
Noah: also audit log UX: list shows raw event ids like `data.purge_triggered`. show friendly title in the table (e.g. 'Retention purge executed') and keep raw id in the expanded JSON.
Izzy: keyboard order: make it toggle -> region -> retention -> key custody -> save. retention changes should announce via aria-live polite: 'Auto-delete set to 30 days'.
Priya: modal copy tweak: replace 'Are you sure?' with 'Permanently delete data after [X days]? This action cannot be undone.' add link to policy and a small second line: 'Consider exporting data first.'
Sam: small experiment idea: retention impact estimator under selector: '~1.1k items (~45MB) will be removed at next purge' — muted text behind FF `retention-estimator-v1`.
Noah: agreed. Sam, can you mock compact row + estimator? Priya/Izzy will review copy/a11y after PR.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: ensure retention dropdown supports arrow keys, estimator region has role="status", and audit rows are keyboard-focusable with aria-expanded.
deploy-bot: FYI staging deploy 2026-07-12 06:00 UTC. include feature flags: `compliance-ux-redo`, `retention-estimator-v1`.
Priya: thanks all — opened TRACK-2217 (retention compact row + copy) and TRACK-2218 (kms custody phrasing + a11y). tagging @Sam @Izzy for follow ups. :thumbsup:
